meta.topStorySummary: The 24-foot "Blue" sculpture, installed 2019, was dismantled without advance public notice.
executiveSummary: This week’s briefing is led by the Kennedy Center’s removal of Joel Shapiro’s Blue sculpture and the Minnesota State Fair’s removal of political crop art after the artist was threatened.

The strongest Black-arts stories include Dance Theatre of Harlem’s 2026–27 touring season, George Washington Carver’s overlooked pigment-making research, and Grantmakers in the Arts’ Black August essay on cultural investment.
On the events side, the calendar uses the September 3–October 4 Radar while carrying forward ongoing and upcoming listings from the last update.
